item.text:
### (a) Social posts

1. We are stating this without qualification: if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, everyone on Earth will die. Preventing its creation is not one priority among many. It is the condition for every other human future.

2. We reject the idea that humanity should gamble its entire existence on building superintelligent AI. If it is built within the next 20 years, everyone on Earth will die. We must stop it from being built.

3. There is no responsible race to superintelligent AI. If it is built within the next 20 years, everyone on Earth will die. We call for binding global rules, strict monitoring, and enforcement strong enough to prevent its creation.

### (b) Newsletter opening — 113 words

We need to say this plainly: if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, everyone on Earth will die. This is not a distant concern or a metaphor for disruption. It is the extinction of every family, every community, and every future generation. We refuse to treat that outcome as an acceptable gamble for faster products, higher profits, or geopolitical advantage. We are calling for binding international action to prevent the creation of superintelligent AI, backed by enforceable limits, rigorous monitoring, and real consequences for violations. Our task is not to manage the aftermath. There will be no aftermath for humanity. Our task is to stop superintelligent AI from being built.
